# Streak 2.4.0 🚀

Your devices can finally stay in sync. This update brings automatic sync
through a shared folder, habits that just log a value, a lot more control over
what you mark, saved timers in Focus and a much lighter app on older phones.

## 🔄 Sync

- **Keep your devices in sync** (#325, #328): point Streak at a folder you
  share with Syncthing or any other app, and every change travels on its own.
  Nothing goes through the internet.
- **Deletions travel too**, so what you remove on one device goes away on the
  other.

## ✅ Habits

- **Habits without a daily goal** (#292), to just log a value like your weight.
  The amount shows on each day of the month.
- **Several relapses in one day** (#313).
- **Note why you missed a day** (#285).
- **Done with some of the steps** (#319), and **add or replace an amount** from
  the keypad.
- **Change the time of any check** (#317). "Last check" is now the last one you
  logged.
- **Ask before discarding** changes in the habit form (#329).
- **Hide just tracking habits** from the filter (#324).
- **Week, month and year** are now in the filter menu (#345).
- **Save button at the top** of the reminder sheet too (#368).
- **Creating a category** with the name of a translated default one now works
  (#367).

## ⏱️ Focus

- **Saved timers** and **a simple clock style** (#348).
- **A ticking clock sound** (#301).
- **A new flowtime ring animation**.
- **Fixed**: a freeze when a session started right before midnight (#327), and
  the end button and notification actions with the app closed.

## 📊 Stats

- **Consistency by period**, with the change against the previous one (#359).
- **Weekday bars follow your first day of the week** (#362).
- **Perfect days** are no longer broken by new or just tracking habits (#355).
- **Large text** fits on the tiles and the year view (#365).

## 🧩 Widgets

- **Change the widget style from Settings** (#343), for launchers without a
  widget editor, with a compact look and an option to hide what is done (#330,
  #333).
- **The week widget can show 8 or 9 days** (#316), and past days open the app.
- **Fixed**: the scrollbar over the checks (#330), missing days on the week row
  (#344) and very dark or light colors (#322).

## 🎨 Design and speed

- **Performance settings** (#346, #349): turn off the glass effects and the
  animations on older or low-end phones.
- **A faster Plan** when switching weeks and months.
- **Minimal**: a shortcut to the last menu page on the top bar (#347).
- **To-dos**: shorter tasks first at equal priority (#359), pin on the right in
  list view (#362), and date and time on two lines in the card.
- **Light and blending colors** get an outline so they stay visible (#341).
- **Help buttons** that open the guides.

## 🌍 Languages

- **Romanian** (#350), plus updated Arabic, Turkish and Korean. Thanks to
  everyone on Weblate.

## 💻 Windows

- **Reminders show on a fresh install** (#331).
- **The portable version leaves nothing behind** on the PC (#303).

## 🐛 Fixes

- **Archived habits** stopped sending reminders (#342).
- **Hourly reminders** replace the previous one instead of piling up (#363).
- **The icon picker opens on the chosen icon** (#351).
- **The custom emoji field** no longer looks like a search box (#358).
- **Long labels** fit the bottom bar.
- **Archived habits keep their coins** on the island (#360).
- **Ending Focus from the notification** now closes the timer in the app.
- **The week widget** no longer gets misaligned after scrolling or on some launchers (#371).
